---
title: "ctDNA technical validity"
date: 2026-08-24
format: html
execute:
  echo: true
  warning: false
  message: false
---

Among attempted samples, technical error is defined as both LOD Q1 and LOD Q3
being missing, because this means that there was an error (e.g., too much hemolysis --> LoD cannot be established.)

```{r}
#| label: technical-validity

source(here::here("R", "analysis-config.R"))

config <- read_analysis_config()
force <- identical(Sys.getenv("LIQPLAT_FORCE"), "1")
samples_path <- here::here(
  "analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-ctdna-samples.parquet"
)
result_dir <- here::here("analysis", "04-implementation", "results")
figure_dir <- file.path(result_dir, "figures")
model_path <- here::here(
  "analysis", "04-implementation", "models", "technical-validity.rds"
)
summary_path <- file.path(result_dir, "technical-validity-summary.parquet")
draws_path <- file.path(result_dir, "technical-validity-draws.parquet")
dir.create(figure_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(dirname(model_path), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

if (force || any(!file.exists(c(summary_path, draws_path, model_path)))) {
  samples <- arrow::read_parquet(samples_path) |>
    as.data.frame()
  attempted <- samples[samples$attempted_sample, ]

  fit <- brms::brm(
    ctdna_error_derived ~ 1 + (1 | id),
    data = attempted,
    family = brms::bernoulli("logit"),
    iter = 2000L,
    chains = 4L,
    cores = 1L,
    seed = analysis_seed(config, "supporting", offset = 2L),
    refresh = 0L
  )
  draws <- marginaleffects::avg_predictions(
    fit, newdata = attempted, type = "response", re_formula = NULL
  ) |>
    marginaleffects::get_draws() |>
    dplyr::select(draw)
  qc_observed <- !is.na(attempted$ctdna_error_qc)
  technical_summary <- data.frame(
    outcome = "technical_error_probability",
    posterior_mean = mean(draws$draw),
    posterior_median = median(draws$draw),
    lower_95 = quantile(draws$draw, 0.025),
    upper_95 = quantile(draws$draw, 0.975),
    n_attempted_samples = nrow(attempted),
    n_attempted_patients = dplyr::n_distinct(attempted$id),
    n_derived_errors = sum(attempted$ctdna_error_derived == 1L),
    n_derived_no_error = sum(attempted$ctdna_error_derived == 0L),
    qc_flag_observed = sum(qc_observed),
    qc_flag_discordant = sum(
      qc_observed & attempted$ctdna_error_qc != attempted$ctdna_error_derived
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  saveRDS(fit, model_path, compress = "xz")
  arrow::write_parquet(draws, draws_path, compression = "zstd")
  arrow::write_parquet(technical_summary, summary_path, compression = "zstd")
}

technical_summary <- arrow::read_parquet(summary_path) |>
  as.data.frame()
```

```{r}
#| label: technical-summary
#| tbl-cap: "Technical validity summary"
#| echo: false

technical_summary |>
  knitr::kable()
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-technical-error-posterior
#| fig-cap: "Posterior probability of a technical error among attempted ctDNA samples. Thick and thin intervals show 66% and 95% credible intervals."
#| fig-alt: "A half-eye density above a posterior dot plot of the probability that an attempted ctDNA sample had a technical error, in percent, averaged over this trial's attempted samples, with thick and thin intervals for the 66 and 95 percent credible intervals."
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5

technical_draws <- arrow::read_parquet(draws_path) |>
  as.data.frame()

technical_posterior_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  technical_draws, ggplot2::aes(x = 100 * draw)
) +
  ggdist::stat_dots(side = "bottom") +
  ggdist::stat_halfeye(.width = c(0.66, 0.95), point_interval = ggdist::median_qi) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Probability of technical error per attempted sample, %", y = NULL) +
  ggplot2::theme_bw() +
  ggplot2::theme(
    axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.y = ggplot2::element_blank()
  )
ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(figure_dir, "technical-error-posterior.png"),
  technical_posterior_plot, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)
technical_posterior_plot
```
